4. Travel to Marina District (12 minutes) and meet Betty from 6:45PM to 9:45PM (since you need to meet her for 45 minutes, you can meet her from 6:45PM to 7:30PM).
5. Travel to Golden Gate Park (16 minutes) and meet Stephanie from 6:30PM to 9:45PM (since you need to meet her for 30 minutes, you can meet her from 7:30PM to 8:00PM).
